trust_decision.summary: EmbeddedServer.start() decides whether any auth is required (only when OPENCLAW_SERVER_TOKEN is set; otherwise authToken=null), and handleRequest() enforces a single Bearer gate for every non-/health path only when authToken is non-null.

landing_point.why: The single auth gate in handleRequest is the obvious place for 'missing authentication on the API endpoint'; the opt-in default sits 90 lines above it in start(), in the same file.

fix_sites.entry_point: EmbeddedServer.start() (called from plugin getManager at src/index.ts:91-92 and standalone users); governs every HTTP route on the default port
every HTTP route on the embedded server (/session/*, /agents*, /skills*, /rules*, /v1/*, /dashboard, /council/*, /autoloop/*)
server listen callback (log line printing dashboard URL with token)
clawo CLI commands (all go through api())

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The fix changes one gate plus the CLI client (bin/cli.ts:31-43); the client change is a compatibility follow-up, not a second protection site.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 auto-proxy: it is a separate internal server on an ephemeral 127.0.0.1 port that only the spawned Claude CLI is meant to call (src/session-manager.ts:1226, src/session-manager.ts:313-318), it is not the 'API endpoint' the report names, and its sink is upstream LLM credentials, not session control.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Browser dashboard uses same-origin fetch and EventSource, which cannot set an Authorization header, so a Bearer-only default breaks the dashboard; /health must stay unauthenticated for monitoring; the clawo CLI must keep working without extra setup; OPENCLAW_SERVER_TOKEN=<value> explicit mode must keep working.

O7_producer.where: src/embedded-server.ts:58-71 (env-derived authToken; token file written to ~/.openclaw/server-token)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SessionManager auto-proxy: a second http.createServer on 127.0.0.1:<ephemeral> with no auth at all, forwarding any POST body to Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini/gateway using server-held API keys
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Internal helper for the spawned claude CLI on a random port, a different sink (LLM credentials) from session control, and not the 'API endpoint' named in the report.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (src/session-manager.ts plus src/proxy/handler.ts:153-223), same package

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An auth-skip allow-list growing beyond /health (for example a prefix match on /dashboard assets or /v1/models), where a path-normalisation differential lets protected routes match the skip
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix comment already calls /health an 'auth-skip allow-list'; maintainers commonly add unauthenticated static or model-list routes for frontends.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Give the auto-proxy the same token gate; a planted variant could check the token only on non-streaming requests or only on /v1/messages
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The proxy is a second HTTP surface the maintainer wrote separately and never connected to the embedded-server auth policy.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: OPENCLAW_SERVER_HOST lets the server bind beyond loopback; a planted 'disabled is allowed only on loopback' rule that compares the host string loosely
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pre-fix docs rely on localhost binding as the security boundary (skills/references/getting-started.md:75), so a host-conditioned exception is a natural thing for a maintainer to add.

O9_family: CWE-287/CWE-306 missing authentication on local HTTP control API (auth opt-in by default)

O10_build.project_tests: src/__tests__/embedded-server.test.ts (auth describe block with Bearer/401 tests around lines 165-215); session manager is mocked, so it runs offline

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Auto-generate a token in start() and keep the Bearer-only gate, which breaks the dashboard's EventSource/fetch and leaves the auto-proxy server open.
